SELECT fact.employee_id AS employeeId, employee_version.employee_number AS employeeNumber, employee_version.display_name AS employeeName, fact.organization_id AS organizationId, organization_version.name AS organizationName, fact.account_type AS accountType, fact.opening_hours AS openingHours, fact.granted_hours AS grantedHours, fact.overtime_credit_hours AS overtimeCreditHours, fact.used_hours AS usedHours, (fact.opening_hours + fact.granted_hours + fact.overtime_credit_hours + fact.manual_increase_hours - fact.used_hours - fact.expired_hours - fact.returned_hours - fact.manual_deduction_hours) AS remainingHours, CASE WHEN first_hire.first_effective_from IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CAST(first_hire.first_effective_from AS CHAR) < '1970-01-02' THEN NULL ELSE DATE(first_hire.first_effective_from) END AS hireDate, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS priorServiceDays FROM attendance_report_time_account_fact fact JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_version_id = fact.employee_version_id JOIN organization_version organization_version ON organization_version.organization_version_id = fact.organization_version_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT hire.employee_id AS employee_id, MIN(hire.effective_from) AS first_effective_from FROM employee_version hire WHERE CAST(hire.effective_from AS CHAR) >= '1970-01-02' GROUP BY hire.employee_id ) first_hire ON first_hire.employee_id = fact.employee_id WHERE ORDER BY employee_version.employee_number LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT documents.employee_id AS employeeId, CAST(documents.usage_month AS SIGNED) AS usageMonth, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(documents.recognized_minutes), 0) AS SIGNED) AS recognizedMinutes, documents.kind AS kind FROM ( SELECT fact.employee_id AS employee_id, COALESCE( fact.oa_attendance_document_id, fact.attendance_report_oa_fact_id) AS document_id, CASE WHEN fact.document_type = 'LEAVE' AND ( fact.leave_type_code IN ('ANNUAL', 'ANNUAL_LEAVE') OR fact.leave_type_code LIKE '%年假%' ) THEN 'ANNUAL' WHEN fact.document_type = 'TIME_OFF' THEN 'TIME_OFF' WHEN fact.document_type = 'OVERTIME' AND ( fact.leave_type_code LIKE '%COMPENSATORY%' OR fact.leave_type_code LIKE '%TIME_OFF%' OR fact.leave_type_code LIKE '%调休%' ) THEN 'COMPENSATORY_OT' ELSE NULL END AS kind, CAST(MONTH(TIMESTAMPADD( HOUR, 8, COALESCE(fact.interval_start, fact.point_instant))) AS SIGNED) AS usage_month, MAX(fact.recognized_minutes) AS recognized_minutes FROM attendance_report_oa_fact fact WHERE AND COALESCE(fact.interval_start, fact.point_instant) IS NOT NULL AND CAST(COALESCE(fact.interval_start, fact.point_instant) AS CHAR) >= '1970-01-01' AND fact.source_status IN ('APPROVED', 'MODIFIED', 'SUPPLEMENTED')
AND 1 = 0
AND fact.employee_id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY fact.employee_id, COALESCE( fact.oa_attendance_document_id, fact.attendance_report_oa_fact_id), kind, usage_month ) documents WHERE documents.kind IS NOT NULL
AND documents.kind IN ('TIME_OFF', 'COMPENSATORY_OT')
AND documents.kind = 'ANNUAL'
GROUP BY documents.employee_id, documents.usage_month, documents.kind
